items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We found out like a year later that Joe Glazer, who was the manager, the booker, was tight with Caesar Petrillo...

ctx.x: Do you remember what your pay was with Lionel before you left?

The pay before I left was like $17 a night when I worked. When you don’t work, you don’t get paid. Out of that $17, you had to pay your hotel rent and everything. It wasn’t much, but if you’re a young teenager or early twenties with no obligations, it was enough. And over there, it probably went up four or five dollars. But what happened before we went there, we were complaining about the money. We went to local 802, and we spoke to somebody in the administration and explained to them what the situation was, and…
Did he play drums at all too?
